title: Tutti: one shared workspace for Claude Code and Codex, no more copy-pasting between agents
description:
When you run Claude Code and Codex on the same project, you become the messenger, pasting one's output into the other and re-explaining context every handoff. Tutti gives them one shared workspace instead. It keeps conversations, files, app outputs, tasks, approvals, and running state connected, so agents can reference each other’s work and you can steer the whole build from one control center. #github #opensource 

https://github.com/tutti-os/tutti
